Mujeeb shortens the length around off; Tilak picks the googly and cuts it through backward point for four.

A pace-off length ball outside off; Tilak pulls it off the back foot to deep square leg for one.

deliveries.commentary: Nabi tosses up an off break on off stump, and Tilak Varma drives firmly but straight back to the bowler for a dot ball.
